pairs.target: huòzhàn de yóudài bǐ tǎ wéi xiǎng de hái xiǎo .
pairs.english: The mailbag at the freight station was smaller than Tavi had expected.
pairs.hanzi: 货站的邮袋比塔维想的还小。

pairs.target: tā yuányǐwéi zǒu nàme yuǎn de lù , zǒng gāi bèizhe yízuò shān shìde dōngxī .
pairs.english: He had imagined that traveling so far must mean carrying something like a mountain on one's back.
pairs.hanzi: 他原以为走那么远的路，总该背着一座山似的东西。

pairs.target: qiáo jiě què bǎ yìzhī zhǎi pídài cóng jiānshàng jiě xiàlái , xiān tāochū bàngè yābiǎn de lí , zài tāochū bāo dé yányánshíshí de xìn .
pairs.english: But Sister Qiao slipped a narrow leather bag from her shoulder, first taking out half a crushed pear, then tightly wrapped letters.
pairs.hanzi: 荞姐却把一只窄皮袋从肩上解下来，先掏出半个压扁的梨，再掏出包得严严实实的信。

pairs.target: lí gē zài guìtái shàng , dài dǐ hái diào chū yì jié cǎo gěng .
pairs.english: The pear went on the counter; a piece of grass stalk also fell from the bag's bottom.
pairs.hanzi: 梨搁在柜台上，袋底还掉出一截草梗。

pairs.target: " zhè yě shì yào sòng de ? " tǎ wéi wèn .
pairs.english: “Is that for delivery too?” Tavi asked.
pairs.hanzi: “这也是要送的？”塔维问。

pairs.target: " zhège shì méi láidejí chī de . " tā shuō , ná xiùzǐ cā le cā lí , yǎodiào yíkuài .
pairs.english: “That is something I haven't had time to eat,” she said, wiping the pear on her sleeve and biting off a piece.
pairs.hanzi: “这个是没来得及吃的。”她说，拿袖子擦了擦梨，咬掉一块。

pairs.target: nà shì yuē hǎo de hòutiān xiàwǔ . tǎ wéi shàng wán kè cái lái ,
pairs.english: It was the agreed afternoon, two days later. Tavi had come after class.
pairs.hanzi: 那是约好的后天下午。塔维上完课才来，

pairs.target: nài lěi yǐjīng jiāo guòlù tú , zhèng tì tā yā zhe yìzhāng juàn biān de shōutiáo .
pairs.english: Nerai had already delivered the map and was holding a curling receipt flat for her.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾已经交过路图，正替她压着一张卷边的收条。

pairs.target: qiáo jiě gèzi bù gāo , bózi shàng de wéijīn rào le sānquān , zuì wài yìquān yǒu gè bèi tàngguò de xiǎo dòng .
pairs.english: Sister Qiao was short, with a scarf wound three times around her neck; its outermost loop had a little burned hole.
pairs.hanzi: 荞姐个子不高，脖子上的围巾绕了三圈，最外一圈有个被烫过的小洞。

pairs.target: tā tóng nài lěi shú dé hěn , xiān wèn shàngcì jiè qù de zhēn hái zài bu zài , yòu wèn tǎ wéi shìbushì nàge yào zhǎo jiù dìmíng de xuéshēng .
pairs.english: She knew Nerai well, first asking whether the borrowed needle was still around, then whether Tavi was the student looking for an old place name.
pairs.hanzi: 她同奈蕾熟得很，先问上次借去的针还在不在，又问塔维是不是那个要找旧地名的学生。

pairs.target: tā bǎ zhǐ dìguòqù . tā kànjiàn yú wān liǎnggè zì , diǎntóu shuō qùguò , méi xiān lùchū tā pàn zhe yòu hàipà de shénqíng .
pairs.english: He handed over the paper. Seeing Elmbay written there, she nodded and said she had been, without the expression he both hoped for and feared.
pairs.hanzi: 他把纸递过去。她看见榆湾两个字，点头说去过，没先露出他盼着又害怕的神情。

pairs.target: " xiànzài hái zhème jiào ? " " rén hái zhème jiào . nǐ wèn nǎgè àn ? "
pairs.english: “Is it still called that?” “People still call it that. Which bank do you mean?”
pairs.hanzi:
“现在还这么叫？”
“人还这么叫。你问哪个岸？”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi lèngzhù . tā zhī zhīdào jiù zhuǎnyùnzhàn .
pairs.english: Tavi froze. All he knew was the old transfer station.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维愣住。他只知道旧转运站。

pairs.target: qiáo jiě bǎ lí hé rēngjìn fèi kuāng , téngchū liǎngzhīshǒu , zài shōutiáo bèimiàn huà le yídào wān xiàn .
pairs.english: Sister Qiao dropped the pear core into a waste basket, freed both hands, and drew a curved line on the back of the receipt.
pairs.hanzi: 荞姐把梨核扔进废筐，腾出两只手，在收条背面画了一道弯线。

pairs.target: yú wān zài dōngàn , jiùzhàn kào shuǐ , pō shàng de wūzi yòu shì lìng yígè jiàofǎ .
pairs.english: Elmbay lay on the east bank. The old station was by the water; the houses on the slope had another name.
pairs.hanzi: 榆湾在东岸，旧站靠水，坡上的屋子又是另一个叫法。

pairs.target: chuán tíng guò hǎojǐgè dìfāng , guāng xiě yú wān , xìn néng dào nà yídài , zhǎo rén hái dé zài wèn .
pairs.english: Boats had stopped at several places. “Elmbay” alone would get a letter to the area; finding a person required more questions.
pairs.hanzi: 船停过好几个地方，光写榆湾，信能到那一带，找人还得再问。

pairs.target: tā náchū zhōushīfu huà de chē ké , yòu bǎ zhuǎnyùnzhàn de shì shuō xì xiē .
pairs.english: He took out Master Zhou's drawing of the vehicle shell and explained the transfer station in more detail.
pairs.hanzi: 他拿出周师傅画的车壳，又把转运站的事说细些。

pairs.target: qiáo jiě méiyǒu jiēzhe cāi . tā shuō zìjǐ méi jiàn guò zhèliàng chē , yě bú jìde zhèzhǒng huí yùn pái ;
pairs.english: Sister Qiao did not start guessing. She said she had never seen that vehicle and did not remember such a return-haul tag.
pairs.hanzi: 荞姐没有接着猜。她说自己没见过这辆车，也不记得这种回运牌；

pairs.target: jiùzhàn jǐnián qián tā guò yíduàn héàn , shōujiàn de dìfāng yǐjīng bān dào pō shàng de wěi jiē .
pairs.english: A section of riverbank at the old station had collapsed a few years ago, and the receiving office had moved to Reed Steps on the slope.
pairs.hanzi: 旧站几年前塌过一段河岸，收件的地方已经搬到坡上的苇阶。

pairs.target: tā qùnián hái zài nàlǐ zhuǎnguò dài , wūyán hěn dī , jìnqù de rén zǒng yào zhuàng yícì cái kěn dītóu .
pairs.english: She had transferred bags there last year; the eaves were so low that people always bumped their heads once before agreeing to duck.
pairs.hanzi: 她去年还在那里转过袋，屋檐很低，进去的人总要撞一次才肯低头。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi kànzhe tā huà de wān xiàn , wèn jiùzhàn shìbushì kōng le .
pairs.english: Tavi looked at her curved line and asked whether the old station was empty.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维看着她画的弯线，问旧站是不是空了。

pairs.target: " zhànfáng kōng le . fùjìn háiyǒu rén shài yú , biétì tāmen quán bānzǒu . "
pairs.english: “The station building is. People still dry fish nearby. Don't move them all away on their behalf.”
pairs.hanzi: “站房空了。附近还有人晒鱼，别替他们全搬走。”

pairs.target: nài lěi xiào le yìshēng . qiáo jiě bǎ bǐjiān wǎng shàng nuó , huà chū yíduàn hěn duǎn de táijiē ,
pairs.english: Nerai laughed. Sister Qiao moved her pen upward and drew a short flight of steps.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾笑了一声。荞姐把笔尖往上挪，画出一段很短的台阶，

pairs.target: shuō xīn tíngchuán chù dé tái zhe dàizǐ shàngqù , lèirén .
pairs.english: She said the new landing meant carrying bags uphill, which was tiring.
pairs.hanzi: 说新停船处得抬着袋子上去，累人。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi běnlái juéde dī chù de héàn yīnggāi kuānkuò , tīngjiàn táijiē , hūrán yòu néng xiǎngxiàng nàlǐ de tuǐjiǎo hé chuǎnqìshēng le .
pairs.english: Tavi had imagined a lowland riverbank ought to be broad and flat. Hearing about steps, he could suddenly imagine people's legs and panting there.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维本来觉得低处的河岸应该宽阔，听见台阶，忽然又能想象那里的腿脚和喘气声了。

pairs.target: tā wèn nàme dī de dìfāng , dōngtiān shìbushì yě huì xiàxuě .
pairs.english: He asked whether it snowed in winter so far down.
pairs.hanzi: 他问那么低的地方，冬天是不是也会下雪。

pairs.target: qiáo jiě shuō shānshàng xià dé zhòng shí , dài shàng huì dài xiàlái , dìshàng liúbúzhù .
pairs.english: Sister Qiao said heavy mountain snow sometimes came down on the bags but would not stay on the ground.
pairs.hanzi: 荞姐说山上下得重时，袋上会带下来，地上留不住。

pairs.target: hébiān yǒuxiē shù zhèshíhòu háishì lǜ de , háizi ná diàoxiàlái de dà yèzi bāo rè yú , yóu lòu dào zhǐtou shàng jiù tiǎn .
pairs.english: Some riverside trees were still green now. Children wrapped hot fish in fallen broad leaves and licked the oil that leaked onto their fingers.
pairs.hanzi: 河边有些树这时候还是绿的，孩子拿掉下来的大叶子包热鱼，油漏到指头上就舔。

pairs.target: tā shuōwán tiǎn le tiǎn zìjǐ zhān lízhī de mǔzhǐ , xiàngshì nàtiáo hé jiù zài guìtái lìngyìbiān .
pairs.english: As she finished, she licked pear juice from her thumb, as though the river lay just across the counter.
pairs.hanzi: 她说完舔了舔自己沾梨汁的拇指，像是那条河就在柜台另一边。

pairs.target: guìtái lǐ de rén cuī tā qiānwán , hòumiàn hái děng zhe yídài zhàngdān .
pairs.english: The clerk urged her to finish signing; another bag of accounts was waiting.
pairs.hanzi: 柜台里的人催她签完，后面还等着一袋账单。

pairs.target: tā shuō zhīdào , xiān bǎ shōutiáo fān zhèng , zǐxì kàn le shùmù cái qiān .
pairs.english: She said she knew, turned the receipt over, and checked the number carefully before signing.
pairs.hanzi: 她说知道，先把收条翻正，仔细看了数目才签。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi wǎng pángbiān tuì , ràngkāi yígè bào zhe mùxiāng de lǎorén .
pairs.english: Tavi stepped aside for an old man carrying a wooden box.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维往旁边退，让开一个抱着木箱的老人。

pairs.target: lǎorén bàoyuàn chuán yòu wǎn le , tā shuō wǎn de shì shàngshān de chē , zìjǐ zài xiàmiàn děng guòbàn sù ,
pairs.english: The man complained that the boat was late again. She said it was the uphill cart that was late; she had waited below for half the night.
pairs.hanzi: 老人抱怨船又晚了，她说晚的是上山的车，自己在下面等过半宿，

pairs.target: bié yí kàn shī xié jiù mà chuán .
pairs.english: He shouldn't blame boats simply because he saw wet shoes.
pairs.hanzi: 别一看湿鞋就骂船。

pairs.target: děng nà rén guòqù , tǎ wéi cái wèn , rúguǒ xiǎng wèn shíduōnián qián yǒuméiyǒu yíliàngchē cóng jiùzhàn tuìhuílái , xìn gāi xiěgěi shuí .
pairs.english: After the man passed, Tavi asked whom to write to about a vehicle returned from the old station more than ten years ago.
pairs.hanzi: 等那人过去，塔维才问，如果想问十多年前有没有一辆车从旧站退回来，信该写给谁。

pairs.target: qiáo jiě bǎ xīn de shōujiàn dìdiǎn xiě zài tā de zhǐ shàng , shuō kě qǐng wěi jiē shōujiàn chù zhuǎn wèn jiùzhàn de rén .
pairs.english: Sister Qiao wrote the new receiving address on his paper and said he could ask the Reed Steps office to pass his question to people from the old station.
pairs.hanzi: 荞姐把新的收件地点写在他的纸上，说可请苇阶收件处转问旧站的人。

pairs.target: tā bùgǎn dāying háiyǒu shuí jìde , yě bùnéng tì yígè bù zhīdào xìngmíng de rén shōuxìn .
pairs.english: She could not promise anyone still remembered, and could not accept a letter on behalf of someone whose name was unknown.
pairs.hanzi: 她不敢答应还有谁记得，也不能替一个不知道姓名的人收信。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi diǎntóu , dīng zhe nà jǐgè xīnzì , réng bù gānxīn shìde wèn le yíjù , jiù bó huì buhuì hái zài .
pairs.english: Tavi nodded, staring at the new characters, then asked as though unable to let go whether the old ledgers might remain.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维点头，盯着那几个新字，仍不甘心似的问了一句，旧簿会不会还在。

pairs.target: " kěnéng bān guò , yě kěnéng shī huài le . wǒ méi kànguò . "
pairs.english: “They may have been moved, or ruined by water. I haven't seen them.”
pairs.hanzi: “可能搬过，也可能湿坏了。我没看过。”

pairs.target: tā shuō dé hěn píngcháng . tā què bǎ bǐ zuàn jǐn le yìdiǎn , zhídào nài lěi dì lái yìzhāng gānjìng zhǐ , cái sōngkāi .
pairs.english: She said it quite ordinarily. But he tightened his grip on the pen until Nerai handed him clean paper, and only then released it.
pairs.hanzi: 她说得很平常。他却把笔攥紧了一点，直到奈蕾递来一张干净纸，才松开。

pairs.target: tā méiyǒu tì tā wèn xià yíjù , zhī bǎ mòshuǐ tuī jìn .
pairs.english: She did not ask the next question for him, only pushed the ink closer.
pairs.hanzi: 她没有替他问下一句，只把墨水推近。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi zài pángbiān de xiǎo zhuōshàng xiěxìn . kāitóu xiě dé tài cháng , bǎ zìjǐ zěnme dào xuégōng yě xiě le jìnqù , dú yíbiàn , yòu huàdiào .
pairs.english: Tavi wrote at a small table nearby. His opening was too long, even including how he had come to the academy; he read it and crossed it out.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维在旁边的小桌上写信。开头写得太长，把自己怎么到学宫也写了进去，读一遍，又划掉。

pairs.target: tā yào wèn de shì jiù yú wān zhuǎnyùnzhàn shíduōnián qián yǒuméiyǒu huísòng guò dài jiǎnxiū jiá cāng de chē ké , yǐjí háiyǒu shuí kěnéng jìde .
pairs.english: His question was whether the old Elmbay transfer station had returned a vehicle shell with a maintenance compartment more than ten years ago, and who might remember.
pairs.hanzi: 他要问的是旧榆湾转运站十多年前有没有回送过带检修夹舱的车壳，以及还有谁可能记得。

pairs.target: tā zhùmíng láizì chāi chēgōng de huíyì , fùshàng nà zhāng jiǎntú de chāoběn , méiyǒu xiě nà dìfāng jiùshì zìjǐ de jiāxiāng .
pairs.english: He identified a dismantling worker's recollection as his source and enclosed a copy of the sketch, without saying the place was his hometown.
pairs.hanzi: 他注明来自拆车工的回忆，附上那张简图的抄本，没有写那地方就是自己的家乡。

pairs.target: xiě dào huíxìn dìzhǐ shí , tā tíng le yíxià , zuìhòu xiě le xuégōng de shōujiàn chù , yòu lìng xiě zìjǐ de míngzì .
pairs.english: He paused at the reply address, finally writing the academy receiving office and his own name separately.
pairs.hanzi: 写到回信地址时，他停了一下，最后写了学宫的收件处，又另写自己的名字。

pairs.target: nài lěi tì tā kànqīng yígè wāi le de zì , méi gǎi tā de wèn fǎ .
pairs.english: Nerai helped him make one crooked character legible without changing how he asked.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾替他看清一个歪了的字，没改他的问法。

pairs.target: yóuzī cóng tā liú zuò tōngxìn de qián lǐ fù , shōutiáo nádào shǒu shí , mò hái méi gān .
pairs.english: The postage came from his correspondence money. The receipt's ink was still wet when he received it.
pairs.hanzi: 邮资从他留作通信的钱里付，收条拿到手时，墨还没干。

pairs.target: qiáo jiě yǐjīng chóngxīn bèi hǎo dàizǐ , shuō xià yítàng xiàhé huì dàizǒu , dào le yǐhòu háiyào zhuǎn wèn ,
pairs.english: Sister Qiao had shouldered her bag again. She said she would take the letter on her next downriver trip, but inquiries would still be needed after it arrived.
pairs.hanzi: 荞姐已经重新背好袋子，说下一趟下河会带走，到了以后还要转问，

pairs.target: bié měitiān zhuī zhe shōuxìn de rén kàn . tǎ wéi wèn tā nàbiān de yèzi yǒu duō dà ,
pairs.english: He should not watch the mail attendant every day. Tavi asked how big the leaves there were.
pairs.hanzi: 别每天追着收信的人看。塔维问她那边的叶子有多大，

pairs.target: tā yòng liǎngzhīshǒu bǐ le bǐ , suíhòu bǎshǒu yòu fàngkuān yìdiǎn .
pairs.english: She spread both hands to show him, then widened them a little more.
pairs.hanzi: 她用两只手比了比，随后把手又放宽一点。

alignment.english: spread both hands to show him

pairs.target: huíchéng lùshang , nài lěi wèn tā shìbushì bǐ láishí duō le wèntí .
pairs.english: On the way back, Nerai asked whether he had more questions than when he came.
pairs.hanzi: 回程路上，奈蕾问他是不是比来时多了问题。

pairs.target: tā shuō shì , yòu shuō zhèhuí zhìshǎo zhīdào xìn wǎng nǎlǐ zǒu .
pairs.english: He said yes, but this time at least he knew where the letter would go.
pairs.hanzi: 他说是，又说这回至少知道信往哪里走。

pairs.target: shānyǐng yāzhù xiàchéng de wūdǐng , gèng yuǎn de hé hái kànbújiàn .
pairs.english: The mountain's shadow pressed over the lower city's roofs; the more distant river was still out of sight.
pairs.hanzi: 山影压住下城的屋顶，更远的河还看不见。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi bǎ xiě zhe wěi jiē de zhǐ shōu jìn yīdài , zǒu le yíduàn , cái xiǎngqǐ nà bàngè lí yěxǔ hái méi chī wán .
pairs.english: Tavi put the paper marked Reed Steps into his pocket. After walking a while, he remembered that half a pear might still be unfinished.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维把写着苇阶的纸收进衣袋，走了一段，才想起那半个梨也许还没吃完。

pairs.target: tā huítóu kàn , huòzhàn ménkǒu yǐ huàn le yì bō děng chē de rén .
pairs.english: He looked back; another group was already waiting for carts outside the station.
pairs.hanzi: 他回头看，货站门口已换了一拨等车的人。
